column1: # mapping_set_title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS records to NIST SP 800-53 Release 5.2.0

# mapping_set_description: Class-level mappings between the records of an ISO/IEC 27001:2022 ISMS and the classes of NIST SP 800-53 Release 5.2.0 that lmodel/nist-sp-800-53 models. Each row maps a class of this schema to a class of the released lmodel/nist-sp-800-53 v0.1.0 schema asset, which tests/neighbours/ holds, named by the IRI the released copy gives it. The rows were first drafted by a language model and then each was checked against both classes' descriptions; a row whose object no released copy holds, or whose meaning did not hold, was dropped. They await review by a person.

column10: The organization's control is one of its own set of controls; an SP 800-53 control is an entry of NIST's catalog
